parts.name: Rotation Blade
parts.Basic_description: This is the rotation blade of a folding knife, made of stainless steel with a sharp edge for cutting.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main cutting component of the knife, capable of slicing or piercing materials when extended.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around a pivot point to fold into or out of the base body for safety and portability.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or handle of the folding knife, made of aluminum alloy for strength and lightness.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a secure grip for the user and houses the rotation mechanism for the blade.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the structural support for the rotating blade.
